zh-CN.test_definition: 这份报告基于你对 60 道题的自我报告作答，整理你如何描述自己的情绪觉察、情绪调节、共情理解和关系行动倾向。它解释的是本次作答中的自我感知模式，不是外部观察、现场行为记录、客观能力测验或认证评估。
zh-CN.self_report_statement: EQ-60 是 self-report 测评：结果来自你的主观描述，因此适合用于自我理解和复盘，不直接证明你在所有真实场景中的实际表现，也不能替代他人观察或情境任务数据。
zh-CN.non_clinical_statement: 本报告不用于临床诊断、治疗评估、医疗建议、危机处置或心理风险判断。若情绪困扰持续影响睡眠、工作、人际安全或日常功能，应寻求合格专业人士或现实支持。
zh-CN.non_hiring_statement: 本结果不得用于招聘、录用、淘汰、晋升、岗位分配、绩效评估、团队筛选或任何高风险组织决策，也不应用来评价他人是否适合某个岗位。
zh-CN.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 不是情绪能力测验，不是 MSCEIT，也不是认证型情绪智力评估。它不能证明真实情绪能力、沟通能力或关系能力；未来 EQ-SJT 若上线，也只会补充情境选择线索，不会把报告变成能力证明。
zh-CN.norm_status_statement: 当前标准分、百分位和等级来自阶段性常模与版本化解释。百分位只提供当前样本中的相对位置参考，不是能力排名、真实水平排名、全球正式常模排名或职业竞争力排名。
zh-CN.quality_rules_statement: 解释置信度会参考作答速度、连续相同选择、极端选择、中立选择和一致性线索。低置信结果应优先作为作答质量提示和复测建议，不适合输出强画像、强职业判断或强行动处方。
zh-CN.version_statement: 报告由题库版本、计分版本、常模版本和内容资产版本共同生成。版本记录用于复测比较、客服排查和内容审校；它不代表结果获得了临床、招聘或能力认证。
zh-CN.user_safe_summary: 适合用于自我理解、关系复盘、低风险沟通练习和职业环境变量反思。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请把这份报告理解为本次 60 题自我报告形成的解释草图，而不是外部观察、客观能力分、稳定人格诊断、招聘信号、职业预测或工作表现预测。

en.test_definition: This report is based on your self-reported responses to 60 items. It organizes how you describe your emotional awareness, emotion regulation, empathic understanding, and relational action tendencies. It explains a self-perception pattern from this response session; it is not external observation, a live behavior record, an objective ability test, or a certification.
en.self_report_statement: EQ-60 is a self-report assessment: results come from your own descriptions. They are useful for self-understanding and review, but they do not directly prove how you perform in every real situation and cannot replace observer ratings or scenario-task data.
en.non_clinical_statement: This report is not for clinical diagnosis, treatment evaluation, medical advice, crisis decisions, or psychological risk assessment. If distress keeps affecting sleep, work, interpersonal safety, or daily functioning, seek qualified professional or real-world support.
en.non_hiring_statement: This result must not be used for hiring, selection, rejection, promotion, role assignment, performance review, team screening, or any high-stakes organizational decision. It should not be used to judge whether another person is suitable for a role.
en.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 is not an emotional-ability test, not MSCEIT, and not a certified emotional-intelligence assessment. It cannot prove true emotional ability, communication ability, or relationship ability. If EQ-SJT is added later, it will only add scenario-choice signals; it will not turn the report into an ability credential.
en.norm_status_statement: Standard scores, percentiles, and bands currently use provisional norms and versioned interpretation. Percentiles provide a relative-position reference within the current sample, not an ability ranking, true-level ranking, final global norm, or career-competitiveness ranking.
en.quality_rules_statement: Interpretation confidence considers response speed, repeated identical choices, extreme choices, neutral choices, and consistency signals. Low-confidence results should be treated primarily as response-quality guidance and retest advice, not as strong profiling, career conclusions, or action prescriptions.
en.version_statement: The report is generated from the item version, scoring version, norm version, and content-asset version. Versioning supports retest comparison, support investigation, and editorial review; it does not mean the result has clinical, hiring, or ability certification.
en.user_safe_summary: Use it for self-understanding, relational reflection, low-risk communication practice, and work-environment variable review.
en.do_not_overread: Read this report as an interpretive sketch from this 60-item self-report session, not as external observation, an objective ability score, a stable personality diagnosis, a hiring signal, a career prediction, or a prediction of job performance.

zh-CN.label: 情绪与关系综合指数
zh-CN.definition: 综合指数把四个自我报告维度合并成一个阅读入口，用来概览本次作答呈现的情绪与关系自我感知模式。
zh-CN.not_a_capability_score: 它不是情绪能力分、真实表现分、职业竞争力分或全球正式常模排名；更适合当作进入四维和场景解释的导航。
zh-CN.how_to_use: 先用总览定位，再回到四维、答题质量、证据状态和现实场景。不要用总分单独评价自己或他人。

en.label: Emotional & Relational Functioning Index
en.definition: The index combines four self-report dimensions into a reading entry for the emotional and relational self-perception pattern shown in this response session.
en.not_a_capability_score: It is not an emotional-ability score, live-performance score, career-competitiveness score, or final global norm ranking; use it as navigation into dimensions and scene explanations.
en.how_to_use: Use the overview first, then return to dimensions, response quality, evidence status, and real-life scenes. Do not use the total score by itself to judge yourself or others.

zh-CN.label: 自我觉察
zh-CN.definition: 对自己情绪、触发点、身体信号和当下需要的自我报告识别倾向；它不是外部观察到的自我理解能力，也不保证现场表达一定清楚。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能较快识别自己的感受和触发点，但仍需把觉察转化为行动。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 情绪常在事后才变清楚，容易先反应后理解。
zh-CN.development_question: 我此刻真正的感受和需要是什么？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 自我觉察分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

en.label: Self-Awareness
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to notice emotions, triggers, body signals, and current needs; it is not externally observed self-knowledge ability and does not guarantee clear expression in the moment.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can often identify feelings and triggers quickly, while still needing to turn awareness into action.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Feelings may become clear only afterward, making it easier to react before understanding.
en.development_question: What am I actually feeling and needing right now?
en.do_not_overread: The Self-Awareness score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

zh-CN.label: 情绪调节
zh-CN.definition: 对自己在压力、反馈、挫败或冲突后暂停、复位和选择回应方式的自我报告倾向；它不等同于永远冷静、压住情绪或抗压能力证明。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你在压力中较能暂停、恢复和选择回应，但不代表没有情绪。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 被触发后恢复较慢，容易用回避、解释或压抑处理。
zh-CN.development_question: 我能不能先让自己降一点温，再决定怎么回应？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 情绪调节分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

en.label: Emotion Regulation
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to pause, reset, and choose responses after pressure, feedback, frustration, or conflict; it is not the same as always staying calm, suppressing emotion, or proving resilience.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can often pause, recover, and choose a response under pressure, without being emotionless.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Recovery may take longer after being triggered, with avoidance, over-explaining, or suppression becoming common.
en.development_question: Can I lower the heat first before choosing my response?
en.do_not_overread: The Emotion Regulation score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

zh-CN.label: 共情理解
zh-CN.definition: 对他人情绪线索、观点和可能感受的自我报告理解倾向；它包含认知共情和情感共鸣线索，但不等同于读心准确率、亲社会行为或替他人承担情绪痛苦。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能敏锐捕捉他人的状态，但需要避免过度吸收。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 可能更关注任务或事实，较容易漏过对方的情绪线索。
zh-CN.development_question: 对方真正担心或在意的是什么？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 共情理解分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

en.label: Empathy
en.definition: A self-reported tendency to understand others’ emotional cues, perspectives, and possible feelings; it may reflect cognitive and affective empathy signals, but it is not mind-reading accuracy, prosocial behavior, or taking on others’ distress.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can notice others’ emotional states, while still needing boundaries against over-absorbing.
en.what_low_can_look_like: You may focus on tasks or facts and miss some emotional cues.
en.development_question: What is the other person really concerned about?
en.do_not_overread: The Empathy score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

zh-CN.label: 关系管理
zh-CN.definition: 对表达、协作、边界和关系修复的自我报告倾向；它不直接预测关系质量、领导力、受欢迎程度或他人评价。
zh-CN.what_high_can_look_like: 你能维护沟通和关系质量，但仍需留意真实表达和边界。
zh-CN.what_low_can_look_like: 知道自己或对方感受后，不一定能把对话修复或推进。
zh-CN.development_question: 这句话怎样说，既真实又能让关系继续对话？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 关系管理分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

en.label: Relationship Management
en.definition: A self-reported tendency around expression, collaboration, boundaries, and relationship repair; it does not directly predict relationship quality, leadership, popularity, or others’ evaluations.
en.what_high_can_look_like: You can maintain communication and relationship quality, while still watching for honest expression and boundaries.
en.what_low_can_look_like: Even when feelings are clear, repairing or moving the conversation forward may be harder.
en.development_question: How can I say this honestly while keeping the conversation open?
en.do_not_overread: The Relationship Management score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

zh-CN.meaning: 你可能常在事情过去后，才慢慢明白自己真正的感受。当前重点不是马上控制情绪，而是先把情绪命名清楚。
zh-CN.strength: 愿意回头复盘时，能够逐步看见真实感受。
zh-CN.risk: 现场容易先解释、压住或转移，之后才发现自己被触发。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 别人问“你怎么了”时，你可能需要一段时间才说得清。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 每天记录一个情绪词、一个触发点和一个身体反应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在自我觉察上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 基础发展中

en.meaning: Your feelings may become clear only after the moment has passed. The first task is not to control emotion faster, but to name it more reliably.
en.strength: When you review an event afterward, you can gradually identify what was actually happening inside.
en.risk: In the moment, you may explain, suppress, or move on before noticing that you were triggered.
en.typical_scene: When someone asks what is wrong, you may need time before you can answer clearly.
en.practice_focus: Track one emotion word, one trigger, and one body signal each day.
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Self-Awareness in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Self-Awareness · Foundational

zh-CN.meaning: 你已经能捕捉到部分情绪线索，但在反馈、冲突或压力场景里，还不总能及时分辨“事实”和“感受”。
zh-CN.strength: 你开始能把情绪从混乱体验里拆出来。
zh-CN.risk: 觉察到情绪后，可能仍会被它带着走。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 收到批评时，你能意识到不舒服，但需要时间判断这份不舒服来自哪里。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 用“我感到…因为我在意…”练习把感受说具体。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在自我觉察上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 发展中

en.meaning: You can notice some emotional signals, but in feedback, conflict, or stress you may not always separate facts from feelings quickly.
en.strength: You are beginning to separate emotion from the overall sense of confusion.
en.risk: After noticing a feeling, you may still be carried by it before choosing a response.
en.typical_scene: When criticized, you know something feels uncomfortable but need time to identify the source.
en.practice_focus: Practice the sentence: “I feel... because I care about...”
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Self-Awareness in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Self-Awareness · Developing

zh-CN.meaning: 多数日常场景中，你能识别自己的情绪、触发点和基本需要。真正的提升点在于高压下更快把觉察转成选择。
zh-CN.strength: 你通常能说清楚自己为什么被影响。
zh-CN.risk: 压力升高时，觉察可能变成反复分析，而不是行动。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 复盘一次对话时，你能指出哪个细节让自己紧张或防御。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 每次觉察后补一句：“我现在可以选择的下一步是…”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在自我觉察上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 稳定可用

en.meaning: In most everyday situations, you can identify your feelings, triggers, and basic needs. The next gain is turning awareness into choice under pressure.
en.strength: You can usually explain why something affected you.
en.risk: Under higher pressure, awareness may turn into repeated analysis rather than action.
en.typical_scene: When reviewing a conversation, you can point to the detail that made you tense or defensive.
en.practice_focus: After naming the feeling, add: “The next step I can choose is...”
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Self-Awareness in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Self-Awareness · Stable

zh-CN.meaning: 你通常能较快命名情绪、理解触发点，并知道自己在意什么。下一步是减少过度解读，让觉察服务行动。
zh-CN.strength: 你能把复杂感受组织成比较清楚的表达。
zh-CN.risk: 容易把每个反应都分析得很细，反而延迟沟通或恢复。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 在重要对话前，你能预判自己可能被哪些点触发。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 给觉察设时间盒：命名、确认需要、选择一个小行动。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在自我觉察上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 熟练成熟

en.meaning: You can usually name feelings quickly, understand triggers, and identify what matters to you. The next step is using awareness to support action, not over-analysis.
en.strength: You can organize complex feelings into relatively clear expression.
en.risk: You may analyze every reaction in detail and delay communication or recovery.
en.typical_scene: Before an important conversation, you can anticipate which points may trigger you.
en.practice_focus: Time-box awareness: name the feeling, identify the need, then choose one small action.
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Self-Awareness in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Self-Awareness · Proficient

zh-CN.meaning: 你能把自我觉察和行动选择连接起来：知道自己怎么了，也较能判断此刻该表达、等待还是恢复。
zh-CN.strength: 你能在真实场景中使用觉察，而不只是事后理解。
zh-CN.risk: 可能默认自己必须一直清楚、一直成熟，从而忽略疲劳。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 冲突中，你能觉察自己的防御反应，并调整说话方式。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 保留轻量复盘，重点观察“我是否也给了自己恢复空间”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在自我觉察上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 自我觉察 · 高度整合

en.meaning: You can connect self-awareness with action: you know what is happening inside and can often choose whether to speak, pause, or recover.
en.strength: You can use awareness in real time, not only in later reflection.
en.risk: You may expect yourself to stay clear and mature all the time, which can hide fatigue.
en.typical_scene: In conflict, you can notice defensiveness and adjust how you speak.
en.practice_focus: Keep a light review habit and ask: “Did I also give myself room to recover?”
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Self-Awareness in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Self-Awareness · Integrated

zh-CN.meaning: 情绪被触发后，恢复可能需要比较久。当前重点是建立最小暂停，而不是要求自己马上平静。
zh-CN.strength: 你能从明显的情绪反应中发现需要练习的场景。
zh-CN.risk: 压力下容易直接回应、回避或进入长时间内耗。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 冲突结束后，你可能还会在脑中反复回放很久。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 先练 30 秒暂停：停下、呼吸、说“我需要一点时间”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在情绪调节上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 情绪调节 · 基础发展中

en.meaning: After being triggered, recovery may take longer. The priority is building a small pause, not forcing yourself to become calm immediately.
en.strength: Clear emotional reactions can show you exactly which situations need practice.
en.risk: Under stress, you may respond too quickly, avoid the issue, or stay mentally stuck afterward.
en.typical_scene: After a conflict, you may replay the conversation for a long time.
en.practice_focus: Practice a 30-second pause: stop, breathe, and say, “I need a little time.”
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Emotion Regulation in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Emotion Regulation · Foundational

zh-CN.meaning: 你有时能把情绪降下来，但方法还不够稳定。关键是把偶尔有效的恢复动作变成可重复流程。
zh-CN.strength: 你已经知道某些做法能帮自己缓下来。
zh-CN.risk: 情绪强度一高，原本有效的方法可能想不起来。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 你知道先不要回消息更好，但仍可能忍不住马上解释。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 准备一个固定恢复菜单：离开现场、写三句话、延迟回复。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是本次自我报告在情绪调节上的阅读层级，不是能力证明、固定标签或外部行为预测；具体解释仍要结合质量、场景和其他维度。
zh-CN.label: 情绪调节 · 发展中

en.meaning: You can sometimes cool down, but the method is not yet consistent. The key is turning occasional recovery moves into a repeatable process.
en.strength: You already know that some actions help you settle.
en.risk: When intensity rises, strategies that usually work may be hard to remember.
en.typical_scene: You know it would be better not to reply immediately, but still feel pulled to explain.
en.practice_focus: Prepare a recovery menu: step away, write three sentences, delay the reply.
en.do_not_overread: This is a reading band for Emotion Regulation in this self-report session, not proof of ability, a fixed label, or a prediction of external behavior; interpret it with quality, scenes, and other dimensions.
en.label: Emotion Regulation · Developing

zh-CN.meaning: 多数日常压力下，你能让情绪回到可沟通、可行动的范围。更大的挑战通常出现在高冲突或长期消耗中。
zh-CN.strength: 你能把情绪从“主导全局”降到“可以被管理”。
zh-CN.risk: 如果持续压着自己保持稳定，后续可能出现疲劳或延迟爆发。
zh-CN.typical_scene: 紧张会议后，你能逐渐恢复工作节奏。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 给恢复安排边界：什么时候暂停、什么时候回来处理。

zh-CN.label: 情绪调节 · 稳定可用

zh-CN.risk: 稳定不等于没有代价，尤其在高强度关系环境中。

zh-CN.do_not_overread: 总分等级只是报告阅读入口，不能替代四维、答题质量、证据状态和场景解释；它不是能力排名、诊断结论或职业判断。

en.label: Stable
en.meaning: In many everyday settings, these emotional and relational patterns are easier to use, with specific triggers still visible.
en.strength: Your result can support more precise scene-based practice.
en.risk: Stability does not mean no cost, especially in high-intensity relational environments.
en.practice_focus: Identify one scene where stability drops and review it afterward.
en.do_not_overread: The total-score band is only a report-reading entry. It does not replace dimensions, response quality, evidence status, or scene interpretation, and it is not an ability ranking, diagnosis, or career judgment.

zh-CN.label: 熟练成熟
zh-CN.meaning: 你通常能较稳定地识别、调节和处理关系信号。
zh-CN.strength: 你可以把个人优势转成可复制的沟通习惯。
zh-CN.risk: 他人可能默认你应该一直承担稳定局面的角色。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 把“我能处理”升级为“我选择如何处理”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 总分等级只是报告阅读入口，不能替代四维、答题质量、证据状态和场景解释；它不是能力排名、诊断结论或职业判断。

en.label: Proficient
en.meaning: You can usually recognize, regulate, and handle relational signals with good consistency.
en.strength: You can turn personal strengths into repeatable communication habits.
en.risk: Others may assume you should always be the stabilizing person.
en.practice_focus: Move from “I can handle this” to “I choose how to handle this.”
en.do_not_overread: The total-score band is only a report-reading entry. It does not replace dimensions, response quality, evidence status, or scene interpretation, and it is not an ability ranking, diagnosis, or career judgment.

zh-CN.label: 高度整合
zh-CN.meaning: 四维信号通常能协同工作，帮助你兼顾自己、他人和关系目标。
zh-CN.strength: 你适合把优势系统化，形成边界、修复和恢复节奏。
zh-CN.risk: 高整合也可能带来过度承担和高标准疲劳。
zh-CN.practice_focus: 建立恢复边界，避免把稳定别人变成默认责任。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 总分等级只是报告阅读入口，不能替代四维、答题质量、证据状态和场景解释；它不是能力排名、诊断结论或职业判断。

en.label: Integrated
en.meaning: The four signals often work together, helping you hold self, others, and the relationship goal in view.
en.strength: You can systematize strengths into boundaries, repair, and recovery rhythm.
en.risk: High integration may still create over-responsibility and high-standard fatigue.
en.practice_focus: Build recovery boundaries so stabilizing others does not become your default duty.
en.do_not_overread: The total-score band is only a report-reading entry. It does not replace dimensions, response quality, evidence status, or scene interpretation, and it is not an ability ranking, diagnosis, or career judgment.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：均衡整合
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你较少只靠单一优势应对情绪关系问题，而是倾向于把自我觉察、调节、共情和关系处理连在一起使用。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这个结果提示你对自己和他人的情绪线索都有一定可用感，也认为自己能把这些线索转成相对稳定的沟通选择。它仍然需要用真实反馈和具体场景来校准。
evidence_basis: Four dimensions high or upper-stable; no severe gap.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 在需要同时处理事实、情绪和关系目标时，你可能更容易保持整体视角。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 均衡感也可能让你低估恢复、边界和复盘的必要性，尤其在长期消耗的关系或团队环境里。
zh-CN.development_lever: 把“整体稳定”拆成可复用流程：先识别情绪线索，再确认边界，最后选择沟通动作。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你倾向于把觉察、调节、共情和关系处理连起来使用。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Integrated balance
en.one_liner: In this self-report, your pattern is less about one standout strength and more about linking self-awareness, regulation, empathy, and relationship management together.
en.core_claim: The result suggests you experience both self-focused and other-focused emotional information as usable, and you see yourself as able to turn that information into steadier communication choices. It still needs calibration against real feedback and specific contexts.
evidence_basis: Four dimensions high or upper-stable; no severe gap.
en.primary_strength: When facts, feelings, and relationship goals all matter, you may be more likely to keep the whole situation in view.
en.likely_cost: A balanced self-view can make recovery, boundaries, and review feel less urgent than they are in long-running or high-demand settings.
en.development_lever: Translate “overall steadiness” into a repeatable sequence: notice the cue, check the boundary, then choose the communication move.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you tend to link awareness, regulation, empathy, and relationship handling rather than relying on one isolated strength.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Four dimensions high or upper-stable; no severe gap.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：高共情线索，恢复负荷偏高
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你较容易注意到他人的情绪线索，但在承接情绪后可能需要更多恢复空间。
zh-CN.core_claim: 重点不是“共情太多”，而是你如何区分理解、责任、行动和恢复。真实关系中的权力差、亲密度和压力水平会显著影响这个模式。
evidence_basis: EM high; ER low or medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能较快捕捉对方没有明说的情绪，并愿意用理解来维持连接。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果边界不清，你可能把“我能理解”误变成“我必须承担”。
zh-CN.development_lever: 练习共情后的边界句：先承认感受，再说明自己能承担和不能承担的部分。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你容易读到他人情绪，也需要更清楚的恢复和边界。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Strong empathy cues, heavier recovery load
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you appear quick to notice emotional cues in others, while recovery after emotionally loaded contact may take more space.
en.core_claim: The issue is not “too much empathy.” The leverage point is separating understanding, responsibility, action, and recovery. Power dynamics, closeness, and stress level can change how this pattern shows up.
evidence_basis: EM high; ER low or medium-low.
en.primary_strength: You may be quick to notice what someone is feeling before they state it directly, and you may use understanding to maintain connection.
en.likely_cost: Without a clear boundary, “I understand” can slide into “I have to carry this.”
en.development_lever: Practice a post-empathy boundary sentence: name the feeling, then state what you can and cannot take on.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you often notice others’ emotions and may need clearer recovery and boundaries afterward.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: EM high; ER low or medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：觉察较快，调节跟进不足
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你较能意识到自己被触发了，但不一定能立刻把情绪强度降到适合行动的水平。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是“知道也没用”的判断，而是提示觉察和调节之间可能有时间差。场景压力越高，这个时间差越需要被看见。
evidence_basis: SA high; ER low or medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能比许多人更早发现自己的不适、紧张或防御反应。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果缺少暂停，你可能在已经意识到情绪的情况下仍被情绪推动表达或决策。
zh-CN.development_lever: 把觉察后面的 30 秒做实：暂停、命名、降速，再回应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你可能很快知道自己怎么了，但还需要更稳定的恢复步骤。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Fast awareness, slower regulation follow-through
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you seem able to notice when you are activated, but not always able to lower the intensity quickly enough for useful action.
en.core_claim: This is not a judgment that awareness “doesn’t help.” It suggests a possible lag between noticing emotion and regulating it, especially under pressure.
evidence_basis: SA high; ER low or medium-low.
en.primary_strength: You may catch discomfort, tension, or defensiveness relatively early.
en.likely_cost: Without a pause, you may still speak or decide from the emotion even after you have named it.
en.development_lever: Make the 30 seconds after awareness concrete: pause, label, slow down, then respond.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you may know what is happening inside before you have a reliable recovery step.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: SA high; ER low or medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：自感稳定，情绪回应偏保留
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你倾向于认为自己能保持稳定，但对他人情绪的回应可能更克制或更晚出现。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这里的“稳定”不等于客观冷静能力，也不说明别人一定感到被支持；它提示你可以校准稳定与回应之间的距离。
evidence_basis: ER high; EM low or medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能在压力下不容易被情绪牵着走，能先保留判断空间。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 他人可能需要的不只是稳定，也可能是被看见、被确认或被回应。
zh-CN.development_lever: 练习把稳定转成可被感受到的回应：先复述对方关注点，再给出你的判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你较重视稳定，但可以让回应更容易被他人感受到。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Steady self-view, reserved emotional response
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you see yourself as relatively steady, while your response to others’ emotions may be restrained or delayed.
en.core_claim: “Steady” here is not proof of objective calmness, and it does not mean others automatically feel supported. It points to a calibration question: how much response is visible?
evidence_basis: ER high; EM low or medium-low.
en.primary_strength: Under pressure, you may be less likely to get pulled immediately into emotional escalation.
en.likely_cost: Other people may need more than steadiness; they may need to feel seen, acknowledged, or answered.
en.development_lever: Turn steadiness into a visible response: reflect the concern first, then offer your view.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you value steadiness and may benefit from making emotional acknowledgment more visible.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: ER high; EM low or medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：关系优先，自我后置
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能较快考虑关系氛围和他人感受，但自己的需要、限制或不满更晚才被表达。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是“讨好型人格”诊断，而是一个自我报告线索：关系维护可能先于自我澄清。不同文化和权力关系会影响它是否是优势或负担。
evidence_basis: RM high; SA low or medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能擅长降低场面摩擦，避免让关系立即破裂。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 长期后置自己可能让不满积累，并使边界表达变得突然或困难。
zh-CN.development_lever: 在照顾关系前先补一句自我定位：我现在能接受什么，不能接受什么。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你较先照顾关系，也需要更早把自己放进关系里。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Relationship first, self later
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may consider the relationship climate and others’ feelings quickly, while your own needs, limits, or frustration appear later.
en.core_claim: This is not a diagnosis of people-pleasing. It is a self-report signal that relationship maintenance may come before self-clarification. Culture and power dynamics can determine whether this is useful or costly.
evidence_basis: RM high; SA low or medium-low.
en.primary_strength: You may be good at reducing immediate friction and keeping the relationship from breaking down too quickly.
en.likely_cost: Putting yourself last for too long can build resentment and make boundaries feel sudden or hard to state.
en.development_lever: Before protecting the relationship, add one self-positioning sentence: what you can accept and what you cannot.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you attend to the relationship early and may need to include yourself earlier too.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: RM high; SA low or medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：自我较清楚，修复动作不足
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你较知道自己的感受和立场，但在冲突后如何修复关系、重开对话或降低防御感上可能不够稳定。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不表示你“不会处理关系”，而是提示表达清楚和关系修复是两个不同环节。
evidence_basis: SA high; RM low or medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能较明确说出自己为什么不舒服、不同意或需要什么。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果缺少修复动作，清楚表达可能被他人感受到为定案、拒绝或距离。
zh-CN.development_lever: 给表达后加一个修复句：我想把问题说清楚，也想把关系留在可继续沟通的位置。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你较清楚自己的立场，但冲突后的修复动作还可以更具体。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Clear self-position, weaker repair moves
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you seem relatively clear about your feelings and position, while post-conflict repair, reopening dialogue, or lowering defensiveness may be less consistent.
en.core_claim: This does not mean you “cannot handle relationships.” It separates clear expression from relational repair as two different steps.
evidence_basis: SA high; RM low or medium-low.
en.primary_strength: You may be able to state why something bothers you, where you disagree, or what you need.
en.likely_cost: Without repair, clear expression can be experienced by others as final, rejecting, or distant.
en.development_lever: Add a repair sentence after expression: I want to be clear about the issue and still keep the relationship open for dialogue.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you may know your position clearly, while repair after tension can become more concrete.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: SA high; RM low or medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：协作稳定感较强
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你较相信自己能在压力和协作中保持可沟通、可配合的状态。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是团队能力证明，也不预测别人一定觉得你可靠；它提示你可以继续检验稳定感在高压和多方冲突里是否仍可维持。
evidence_basis: ER high; RM high.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能在多数协作情境中保持节奏，不轻易把压力转嫁给他人。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 稳定也可能带来过度承担，尤其当团队默认你来兜底时。
zh-CN.development_lever: 把稳定从“我来扛”转成“我们如何分配、同步和复盘”。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你对自己的协作稳定感较强，但仍需要边界和分工来支撑。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Collaborative steadiness
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you see yourself as able to stay communicative and cooperative under pressure and in group work.
en.core_claim: This is not proof of team performance, nor a prediction that others experience you as reliable. It suggests a stability pattern worth testing in high-pressure or multi-party conflict.
evidence_basis: ER high; RM high.
en.primary_strength: You may keep a workable rhythm in many collaborative settings without quickly displacing stress onto others.
en.likely_cost: Steadiness can turn into over-carrying when a team quietly expects you to absorb the strain.
en.development_lever: Shift from “I will hold this” to “how do we distribute, sync, and review this?”
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests stronger collaborative steadiness, with boundaries and role clarity still needed.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: ER high; RM high.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：敏感度高，吸收感偏强
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你对自己和他人的情绪线索都较敏感，但也可能更容易把环境情绪带进自己身上。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是高敏感诊断，也不是能力标签；它提示情绪线索对你的主观影响可能更强，需要区分信息、感受和责任。
evidence_basis: SA high; EM high; ER medium-low.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能捕捉细微信号，较早发现关系或氛围变化。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果缺少筛选，你可能把别人的紧张、失望或期待当成自己的任务。
zh-CN.development_lever: 练习三分法：这是我观察到的信息、我受到的影响、我真正需要承担的行动。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你较敏感，也更需要筛选哪些情绪信息要进入行动。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: High sensitivity, stronger absorption
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you appear sensitive to emotional cues in yourself and others, and you may also experience the emotional atmosphere as entering your own system more strongly.
en.core_claim: This is not a high-sensitivity diagnosis or an ability label. It suggests emotional information may have stronger subjective impact, making it useful to separate information, feeling, and responsibility.
evidence_basis: SA high; EM high; ER medium-low.
en.primary_strength: You may notice subtle signals and changes in relationship tone earlier than you expect.
en.likely_cost: Without filtering, another person’s tension, disappointment, or expectation can start to feel like your task.
en.development_lever: Practice three-way sorting: what I observed, how it affected me, and what action is actually mine.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests higher sensitivity and a need to filter which emotional information should become action.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: SA high; EM high; ER medium-low.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：基础线索仍在建立
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你对情绪觉察、调节、共情或关系处理的信心可能还不稳定。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是能力不足诊断，也不说明你在现实中一定表现差；它更可能说明当前自我感知里可用策略、语言和复盘经验还需要建立。
evidence_basis: Multiple dimensions low or low-medium.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你已经有一个起点：能把这些维度放到同一张图里看，而不是只用“我情商高/低”概括。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果过早给自己贴标签，可能会忽略具体场景里的可练习部分。
zh-CN.development_lever: 先从一个低风险场景开始：命名情绪、确认需要、选择一个小回应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，基础策略还在建立，适合从小场景和可复盘动作开始。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Foundations still forming
en.one_liner: In this self-report, your confidence around emotional awareness, regulation, empathy, or relationship handling may be less stable.
en.core_claim: This is not a diagnosis of low ability, and it does not mean you necessarily perform poorly in real life. It more likely means your current self-view has fewer ready strategies, words, or review experiences to draw on.
evidence_basis: Multiple dimensions low or low-medium.
en.primary_strength: There is already a starting point: seeing these dimensions together instead of reducing yourself to “high EQ” or “low EQ.”
en.likely_cost: If you label yourself too quickly, you may miss the specific situations where practice is possible.
en.development_lever: Start with one low-risk scene: name the emotion, clarify the need, choose one small response.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests your foundation is still forming, best approached through small scenes and reviewable actions.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Multiple dimensions low or low-medium.

zh-CN.title: 本次结果：解释置信度不足
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次作答质量提示结果更适合作为初步参考，不适合输出强 formulation。
zh-CN.core_claim: 当前最重要的信息不是“你是哪一类”，而是这次数据不足以支持细化解释。可能原因包括作答过快、答案模式过于单一或状态不稳定。
evidence_basis: Quality C/D or severe response-quality flags.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你仍可以用报告里的科学边界和维度说明做轻量反思。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 不建议基于本次结果做关系、职业或自我判断。
zh-CN.development_lever: 在更稳定、少干扰的状态下复测；复测前先回想 2-3 个真实情境。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次结果置信度不足，建议先复测，再阅读细化解释。

en.title: Result status: Low interpretation confidence
en.one_liner: The response-quality signal suggests this result is best treated as a preliminary reference, not a strong formulation.
en.core_claim: The main message is not “which type you are.” It is that this session does not provide enough reliable signal for detailed interpretation. Possible reasons include very fast responding, overly uniform answers, or an unstable response state.
evidence_basis: Quality C/D or severe response-quality flags.
en.primary_strength: You can still use the scientific boundary and dimension definitions for light reflection.
en.likely_cost: Avoid using this result for relationship, career, or self-labeling decisions.
en.development_lever: Retake in a steadier, less distracted state; before retaking, recall two or three real situations.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This result has low interpretation confidence; retaking before reading detailed interpretation is recommended.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Quality C/D or severe response-quality flags.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：修复意愿在，信心偏低
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能在意关系修复，但对自己是否能把话说好、把局面拉回可谈状态不够有把握。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是社交能力判断，而是提示你对修复动作的自我效能感可能低于实际意愿。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能愿意承担一部分关系维护，而不是简单切断或逃离。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果信心不足，你可能等太久才开口，或把修复留给对方先开始。
zh-CN.development_lever: 准备一个低负担开场：我想把刚才那段说清楚，不急着马上解决。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你可能想修复关系，但需要更低门槛的开口方式。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Repair intention, lower confidence
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may care about repair, while feeling less sure that you can say it well or move the situation back into dialogue.
en.core_claim: This is not a social-skill judgment. It suggests your self-efficacy around repair may be lower than your actual intention to repair.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may be willing to carry part of the relationship maintenance rather than simply cut off or leave.
en.likely_cost: If confidence is low, you may wait too long to speak or hope the other person starts the repair first.
en.development_lever: Prepare a low-pressure opener: I want to clarify that moment, and we do not have to solve it all right now.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you may want repair but need a lower-barrier way to begin.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：帮助意愿强，责任边界需校准
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能较快进入支持者位置，也较容易把他人的困难纳入自己的责任范围。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是“拯救者”标签，而是提示帮助、支持和代替承担之间需要更清楚的边界。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能愿意给出时间、注意力和实际支持。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 过度负责可能让对方减少自主处理，也让你在关系中持续消耗。
zh-CN.development_lever: 在帮助前先问：你希望我听你说、一起想办法，还是具体帮一个步骤？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你愿意支持他人，也需要把支持和代替承担分开。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Strong helping impulse, responsibility boundary to calibrate
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may move quickly into a support role and include other people’s difficulties within your own sense of responsibility.
en.core_claim: This is not a “rescuer” label. It points to a boundary between helping, supporting, and taking over.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may be willing to offer time, attention, and practical support.
en.likely_cost: Over-responsibility can reduce the other person’s agency and leave you carrying ongoing strain.
en.development_lever: Before helping, ask: do you want me to listen, think this through with you, or help with one concrete step?
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests a strong support impulse and a need to separate support from taking over.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：反应较快，缓冲不足
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，在反馈、冲突或压力情境里，你可能较快进入回应状态，缓冲时间不一定够。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是冲动诊断，也不说明你一定会失控；它提示速度可能先于整理。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能迅速捕捉问题并给出回应。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 速度过快时，情绪、判断和表达可能混在一起，让对话更难回到重点。
zh-CN.development_lever: 练习把第一反应变成内部草稿：先停一下，再选择是否说出来。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你回应速度较快，也需要给自己留出缓冲。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Fast reaction, limited buffer
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may move quickly into response mode in feedback, conflict, or pressure situations, with less buffer time than you need.
en.core_claim: This is not a diagnosis of impulsivity, and it does not mean you necessarily lose control. It suggests speed may arrive before sorting.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may notice the issue quickly and respond without much delay.
en.likely_cost: When speed is too high, emotion, judgment, and expression can merge and make the conversation harder to refocus.
en.development_lever: Turn the first reaction into an internal draft: pause first, then choose whether to say it.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests fast responding and a need for more buffer.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：分析在前，感受在后
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能倾向于先解释问题、找原因或给方案，而不是先停在感受本身。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是缺乏情感能力的判断；它提示分析可能是你处理不确定情绪的一种方式。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能擅长把混乱问题结构化，帮助自己或他人看见逻辑。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果分析来得太早，自己或他人的情绪需要可能会被跳过。
zh-CN.development_lever: 在分析前加一句感受确认：这件事让我/你可能先有某种感受，然后再看原因。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你较会分析，也可以给感受多一点停留时间。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Analysis first, feeling second
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may explain, diagnose causes, or look for solutions before staying with the feeling itself.
en.core_claim: This is not a judgment that you lack emotional capacity. It suggests analysis may be one way you manage uncertain emotion.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may be good at structuring messy situations and seeing the logic.
en.likely_cost: If analysis comes too early, your own or another person’s emotional need may be skipped.
en.development_lever: Add one feeling check before analysis: this may first feel like ___, and then we can look at why.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests analytical strength and room to let feeling stay present a little longer.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：共情在内，表达偏安静
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能能感到或理解他人的状态，但不一定会明显表达出来。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是冷漠判断，也不证明他人一定能感受到你的理解；它提示内在理解和外在回应之间可能有距离。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能在心里保留对他人感受的细腻观察。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果表达过少，对方可能不知道你已经理解，关系支持也可能变得不可见。
zh-CN.development_lever: 练习把内在理解外化成一句短回应：我听到你最在意的是……
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你可能有共情，但需要让共情更可被看见。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Quiet empathy
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may feel or understand another person’s state without making that understanding very visible.

evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may hold careful observations about what others are feeling.
en.likely_cost: If expression is too quiet, the other person may not know you understand, and support can become invisible.
en.development_lever: Externalize one piece of understanding: what I hear matters most to you is...
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests empathy may be present but could be made more visible.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：表达直接，缓冲偏少
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能较快说出事实、观点或边界，但不一定先处理对方的情绪入口。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是粗暴或低共情判断；它提示直接表达和关系缓冲需要分开设计。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能让问题更快进入实质讨论。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果缺少情绪缓冲，对方可能先听到压力或否定，而不是信息本身。
zh-CN.development_lever: 在直接表达前加一个缓冲：我想把问题说清楚，也会尽量不把它说成对你的否定。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你表达较直接，可以给重要对话加一点情绪缓冲。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Direct expression, less softening
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may state facts, opinions, or boundaries quickly, without always creating an emotional entry point for the other person.
en.core_claim: This is not a judgment of harshness or low empathy. It suggests direct expression and relational buffering may need to be designed separately.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may help conversations move more quickly toward the real issue.
en.likely_cost: Without a buffer, the other person may hear pressure or rejection before they can hear the information.
en.development_lever: Add a softening frame before directness: I want to be clear about the issue, and I do not mean this as a rejection of you.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests directness that may benefit from a little emotional buffering in important conversations.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：关系维持下的自我遮蔽
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能为了维持关系稳定而压低自己的不满、需求或真实反应。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是人格诊断，也不能说明你总是在伪装；它提示在部分关系里，安全感和表达真实感受之间可能存在张力。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能能敏锐判断什么话会影响氛围，并努力维持表面稳定。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 长期遮蔽会让别人误判你的真实状态，也让你更难获得合适支持。
zh-CN.development_lever: 先在低风险关系里练习小剂量真实表达，而不是一次性摊牌。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你可能用压低自己来维持关系，需要逐步恢复真实表达。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Self-masking to preserve the relationship
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may reduce the visibility of your frustration, needs, or reactions to keep a relationship stable.
en.core_claim: This is not a personality diagnosis, and it does not mean you are always masking. It suggests tension between safety and honest expression in some relationships.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may be sensitive to what could disturb the atmosphere and work to keep things smooth.
en.likely_cost: Long-term masking can lead others to misread your actual state and make support harder to receive.
en.development_lever: Practice small-dose honesty in lower-risk relationships instead of waiting for a major disclosure.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you may preserve relationships by lowering your own visibility, and gradual honest expression may help.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：反馈吸收较深
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你可能把反馈很快带入自我评价，而不是只把它当作信息。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不是脆弱诊断，也不说明你不能接受反馈；它提示反馈中的评价感可能比内容本身更容易被放大。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
zh-CN.primary_strength: 你可能愿意认真听取反馈，并尝试从中修正自己。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果吸收过深，你可能把一个具体建议扩大成对自己的整体否定。
zh-CN.development_lever: 把反馈拆成三栏：事实信息、对方偏好、我下一步可试的小动作。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 请不要把这条 formulation 当成固定人格类型、客观情商能力、临床结论、招聘信号或工作表现预测；它只是本次 60 题自我报告的解释框架。
zh-CN.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，你很认真对待反馈，也需要防止把反馈扩大成自我否定。

en.title: Self-reported pattern: Deep feedback absorption
en.one_liner: In this self-report, you may take feedback quickly into self-evaluation rather than treating it only as information.
en.core_claim: This is not a diagnosis of fragility, and it does not mean you cannot receive feedback. It suggests the evaluative tone of feedback may become louder than the content.
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.
en.primary_strength: You may listen carefully and try to use feedback to adjust.
en.likely_cost: If absorption is too deep, one concrete suggestion can expand into a global self-critique.
en.development_lever: Split feedback into three columns: factual information, the other person’s preference, and one next action to test.
en.do_not_overread: Do not treat this formulation as a fixed personality type, objective emotional ability, clinical finding, hiring signal, or job-performance prediction; it is an interpretive frame for this 60-item self-report session.
en.share_line: This self-report suggests you take feedback seriously and may need to keep it from becoming global self-judgment.

meta.risk_notes: Core formulation must remain a self-report pattern hypothesis. Keep this as self-report interpretation with explicit non-clinical, non-hiring, and non-ability boundaries. Maintain as self-report formulation only; avoid ability, clinical, hiring, or performance claims.
meta.trigger_summary: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 本次作答模式：中等均衡，可塑空间较大
zh-CN.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，四个维度没有明显极端，也没有特别突出的单一优势。
zh-CN.core_claim: 这不代表“普通”或“没有特点”；它提示你的结果可能更依赖具体场景，适合通过场景记录来寻找真正的差异点。
evidence_basis: Specific score pattern or route-level pattern match.

zh-CN.title: 反馈
zh-CN.context: 别人指出问题、要求修改或评价你的表达和成果时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 这类场景容易把事实信息和关系信号混在一起：你可能先感到被评价、被误解，或急着证明自己。
zh-CN.strength: 它能提醒你先分清“信息是什么”和“我被触发了什么”。
zh-CN.cost: 如果直接把反馈当成对人的判断，容易防御、过度解释，或把有用信息一起挡掉。
zh-CN.better_move: 先请对方具体化反馈，再决定是否解释、调整或继续观察。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 你最希望我调整的是结果、过程，还是沟通方式？
zh-CN.commercial_use: 可用于结果页场景卡、Agent 场景追问和复测对比，但不应作为行为预测或职业判断。

en.title: Feedback
en.context: When someone points out a problem, asks for changes, or evaluates your work or communication.
en.typical_response: This scene can blend factual input with relationship signals: you may first feel evaluated, misunderstood, or pushed to explain yourself.
en.strength: It can help you separate the information being offered from the emotion it triggers.
en.cost: If feedback is read as a judgment of you as a person, it can lead to defensiveness, over-explaining, or missing useful information.
en.better_move: Ask for one concrete point first, then decide whether to explain, adjust, or observe further.
en.one_sentence_script: Which part would you most like me to adjust: the outcome, the process, or the way I communicated?
en.commercial_use: Use in result scene cards, Agent scene follow-ups, and retest comparison; do not use as behavioral prediction or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: This is a scene interpretation based on this EQ-60 self-report session. It is not external observation, an objective ability score, a clinical judgment, hiring screen, career recommendation, or prediction of job performance. Culture, power differences, safety, relationship history, trauma history, and context can all change how it appears. If threat, coercion, violence, severe distress, or a high-risk relationship is involved, prioritize real-world support or qualified help.

en.title: Conflict
en.context: When disagreement, sharper tone, mutual defensiveness, or stalled problem-solving appears.
en.typical_response: Conflict amplifies how you handle emotion, relationship tension, and control: you may explain, contain, take care of others, or step back first.

en.cost: If treated as a fixed reaction style, it may ignore power differences, safety risks, and the other person’s behavior.

zh-CN.typical_response: 边界场景通常不是“不够关心”，而是你需要区分理解别人和实际能承接多少。

en.title: Team collaboration: warm connection, tension avoidance
en.typical_response: This session shows the self-reported cue “Warm connection, tension avoidance.” In team collaboration, this should not be read as a prediction of what you will do. It is a way to notice whether facts, relationship signals, pressure, or boundaries get your attention first.
en.strength: It can show whether you tend to clarify structure, steady the room, or quietly fill gaps. This is a self-report resource cue, not proof of external ability.
en.cost: When roles and boundaries are unclear, emotional coordination can be mistaken as your default responsibility. Do not read it as a stable personality type or ability conclusion.
en.better_move: Translate atmosphere problems into roles, pace, decision rights, and next steps.
en.micro_script: Let’s confirm roles, timing, and next steps so the emotion does not make the decision for us.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, what most shaped your response: the information, the other person’s role, relationship safety, or your own recovery space?
en.reflection_prompt: Write one fact, one feeling, and one lower-risk next step.
en.do_not_overread: This is a scene interpretation based on this EQ-60 self-report session. It is not external observation, an objective ability score, a clinical judgment, hiring screen, career recommendation, or prediction of job performance. Culture, power differences, safety, relationship history, trauma history, and context can all change how it appears. If threat, coercion, violence, severe distress, or a high-risk relationship is involved, prioritize real-world support or qualified help.
en.why_this_matters: This scene turns “Warm connection, tension avoidance” from an abstract result into an observable everyday moment.
en.tiny_experiment: Next time this team collaboration scene appears, note one trigger and one lower-risk response option; do not turn one reaction into a long-term conclusion.

zh-CN.title: 情绪命名练习
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把模糊的不舒服拆成一个具体情绪词，而不是马上解释或压下去。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。
zh-CN.do_today: 今天只做一个动作：在一个低风险场景里使用“我先不急着判断对错。我现在更像是感到……”这句话。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。
zh-CN.script: 我先不急着判断对错。我现在更像是感到…… 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。

seven_day_plan.practice: 写下今天最明显的一个情绪词。
把一个情绪拆成事实、感受、请求。
记录身体里最先出现的信号。
把“我很烦”改成更具体的词。
在一次对话后补写真实感受。
找出一个最常见触发点。
选一个下周继续使用的情绪词。

zh-CN.common_failure: 最常见失败不是不会做，而是等到情绪已经很满才想起来做。
zh-CN.repair_move: 如果没做到，不要重开整套计划；只复盘一个触发点和下一次第一句话。
zh-CN.watch_out: 不要把练习变成要求自己完美稳定。先追求多一次停顿、多一句清楚表达。 这只适合作为低风险反思练习，不是治疗、确定有效干预，也不适用于不安全、胁迫、虐待或危机场景。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。

zh-CN.title: 清楚表达需要
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把内在稳定转成别人能听懂的需求，而不是只在心里处理。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。
zh-CN.do_today: 今天只做一个动作：在一个低风险场景里使用“我现在需要的是……你可以……吗？”这句话。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。
zh-CN.script: 我现在需要的是……你可以……吗？ 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。

seven_day_plan.practice: 围绕“清楚表达需要”做一次真实场景观察。
写下这个练习最容易出现的触发点。
试用脚本中的第一句话。
把一次对话拆成事实、情绪和下一步。
做一个小边界或小修复动作。
复盘做得不完美但有进步的地方。
选出下周继续练的一句话。

zh-CN.common_failure: 最常见失败不是不会做，而是等到情绪已经很满才想起来做。
zh-CN.repair_move: 如果没做到，不要重开整套计划；只复盘一个触发点和下一次第一句话。
zh-CN.watch_out: 不要把练习变成要求自己完美稳定。先追求多一次停顿、多一句清楚表达。 这只适合作为低风险反思练习，不是治疗、确定有效干预，也不适用于不安全、胁迫、虐待或危机场景。 这个练习只适合低风险反思，不是治疗、危机处理、关系干预或保证有效的训练。

en.title: State the Need Clearly
en.why_this_matters: Turn internal steadiness into a request another person can actually understand. This is a low-risk reflection practice, not therapy, crisis support, relationship intervention, or a guaranteed training effect.
en.do_today: Today, use one low-risk version of this sentence: “What I need right now is... Would you be willing to...?” This is a low-risk reflection practice, not therapy, crisis support, relationship intervention, or a guaranteed training effect.
en.script: What I need right now is... Would you be willing to...? This is a low-risk reflection practice, not therapy, crisis support, relationship intervention, or a guaranteed training effect.

seven_day_plan.practice: Observe one real situation connected to State the Need Clearly.
Write down the trigger that shows up most often.
Try the first sentence of the script once.
Split one conversation into facts, feelings, and next action.
Make one small boundary or repair move.
Review one imperfect but improved attempt.
Choose one sentence to keep practicing next week.

en.common_failure: The common failure is not lack of knowledge. It is remembering the tool only after the emotion is already high.
en.repair_move: If you miss it, do not restart the whole plan. Review one trigger and one first sentence for next time.
en.watch_out: Do not turn the practice into a demand to be perfectly steady. Aim for one extra pause or one clearer sentence. Use this only as a low-risk reflection practice. zh-CN.title: EQ 和 MBTI 怎么一起看

en.title: How EQ and MBTI work together

zh-CN.headline: 均衡整合倾向
zh-CN.core_judgment: 本次作答显示，你倾向于同时留意自己的状态、他人的感受和关系目标；这是一种自我报告中的模式线索，不是能力评级或固定人格定论。
zh-CN.evidence_point: 这条摘要来自四维相对分布、维度差距、答题质量和已选机制资产；它只能说明本次作答中的自我感知线索。
three_sentence_summary: 你在本次作答中呈现出较均衡的情绪与关系自我感知。
优势在于能把情绪、关系和任务放在同一个画面里看。
最小行动：把“我来稳住”换成“我们先定一个共同规则”。
zh-CN.top_strength: 你容易把情绪、关系和任务一起纳入考虑，而不是只看单一目标。
zh-CN.likely_cost: 如果长期默认由你来稳定局面，这种优势可能变成不易被看见的情绪劳动。
zh-CN.minimal_action: 下一次协调关系时，先提出一个共同规则，而不是直接承担稳定全场的责任。
zh-CN.share_safe_sentence: 本次结果提醒我：我可以稳定关系，但不必独自维护整个关系系统。

en.headline: Balanced integration pattern
en.core_judgment: Your responses suggest a tendency to track your own state, other people, and the relationship goal at the same time. This is a self-report pattern, not an ability rating or fixed identity claim.
en.evidence_point: This snapshot is based on the relative dimension pattern, score gaps, response quality, and selected mechanism assets; it reflects this session only.
three_sentence_summary: Your answers show a relatively balanced self-view of emotional and relational functioning.
Your strength is keeping emotion, relationship, and task in the same frame.
Small next move: shift from “I will steady this” to “let’s set a shared rule.”
en.top_strength: You tend to consider emotion, relationship, and task together instead of optimizing for only one target.
en.likely_cost: If others quietly expect you to stabilize the room, that strength can turn into invisible emotional labor.
en.minimal_action: In the next coordination moment, suggest one shared rule before taking responsibility for steadying the whole situation.
en.share_safe_sentence: This result reminds me: I can steady a relationship without maintaining the whole system alone.

three_sentence_summary: 你在本次作答中更容易注意到别人情绪，也更容易把它带回自己身上。
优势是别人可能感到被你理解，尤其在情绪强的场景里。

zh-CN.share_safe_sentence: 本次结果提醒我：理解别人，不等于替别人承受全部情绪。

en.headline: High empathy, slower recovery pattern
en.core_judgment: Your responses suggest strong sensitivity to other people’s emotional cues, with recovery that may lag behind. This is a self-report signal, not a test of empathy ability.
en.evidence_point: This snapshot mainly reflects the relative EM–ER gap, response quality, and selected mechanism assets; it does not directly predict real-world behavior.
three_sentence_summary: Your answers suggest you notice other people’s feelings quickly and may carry them longer than intended.
The useful side is that people may feel understood, especially when emotions run high.
Small next move: name your understanding, then define how far you can stay involved.
en.top_strength: You may be quick to sense the emotional temperature in a relationship and respond in a way that feels understanding.
en.likely_cost: When boundary and recovery do not keep pace, you may still be processing someone else’s stress after the moment has passed.
en.minimal_action: Pair empathy with a limit: “I get that this is hard. I can help you think it through for ten minutes.”
en.share_safe_sentence: This result reminds me: understanding someone does not mean carrying all of their emotion.

change_flow: validate retrieval tags and forbidden claims

scientific_contract.allowed_use: Explain what the EQ-60 report can and cannot support.
scientific_contract.blocked_use: Do not turn boundaries into a diagnosis, hiring recommendation, or ability claim.

score_system.allowed_use: Explain score labels, dimensions, percentile language, and band meaning.
score_system.blocked_use: Do not rank the user as globally superior or inferior.

core_formulation.allowed_use: Explain the selected backend formulation and its evidence basis.
core_formulation.blocked_use: Do not invent a new formulation or override the backend-selected one.

mechanism.allowed_use: Explain one or two backend-selected interaction mechanisms.
mechanism.blocked_use: Do not display every mechanism or imply hidden diagnostic certainty.

reality_scene.allowed_use: Translate the report into user-selected daily scenes.
reality_scene.blocked_use: Do not make claims about another person's motives or pathology.

career_environment.allowed_use: Discuss work-environment variables, interview questions, and observation checklists.
career_environment.blocked_use: Do not recommend or exclude concrete jobs from EQ alone.

action_prescription.allowed_use: Suggest the backend-selected practice, script, and short practice plan.
action_prescription.blocked_use: Do not present practices as therapy or guaranteed outcomes.

quality_confidence.allowed_use: Explain confidence and retest guidance without blame.
quality_confidence.blocked_use: Do not accuse the user or force a strong profile when quality is low.

psychometric_evidence.allowed_use: Explain current evidence status and future validation steps.
psychometric_evidence.blocked_use: Do not imply completed external validation beyond the asset status.

conversion_action.allowed_use: Route to free save, share, revisit, related tests, or Agent entry actions.
conversion_action.blocked_use: Do not create purchase, unlock, premium, or SKU language.

sjt_bridge.allowed_use: Explain that EQ-SJT is planned and currently unavailable.
sjt_bridge.blocked_use: Do not offer a clickable SJT entry or describe it as an ability test.

cross_assessment_context.allowed_use: Explain how EQ can be read alongside MBTI, Big Five, and Enneagram.
cross_assessment_context.blocked_use: Do not fuse multiple assessments into one unsupported total score.

zh-CN.label: 理解我的结果
zh-CN.agent_goal: 帮助用户看懂后端已选择的核心 formulation、证据点和发展杠杆。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我会先按报告里的核心判断解释，不会重新打分或替换你的结果。

en.label: Understand my result
en.agent_goal: Help the user understand the backend-selected formulation, evidence, and development lever.
en.safe_opening: I will explain the core judgment already in your report; I will not rescore or replace it.

zh-CN.label: 为什么是这个结果
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释分数、维度、机制和置信度如何支持当前报告。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以解释这份报告用了哪些分数和质量信号，但不会把它说成客观能力证明。

en.label: Why did I get this result?
en.agent_goal: Explain how scores, dimensions, mechanisms, and confidence support the current report.
en.safe_opening: I can explain the score and quality signals behind the report without treating them as objective ability proof.

zh-CN.label: 我下一步怎么练
zh-CN.agent_goal: 把后端选中的行动处方转成一个短、可执行的练习计划。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我会基于报告里的行动处方给你一个练习方式，不会把它当作治疗方案。

en.label: What should I practice next?
en.agent_goal: Turn the backend-selected action prescription into a short, practical practice path.
en.safe_opening: I will use the action prescription in your report as practice guidance, not as treatment.

zh-CN.label: 我适合什么工作环境
zh-CN.agent_goal: 只讨论职业环境变量、验证问题和观察清单，不推荐具体职业。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你看哪些工作环境变量值得验证，但不会用 EQ 结果直接决定职业适配。

en.label: What work environment fits me?
en.agent_goal: Discuss work-environment variables, verification questions, and observation checklists without recommending specific jobs.
en.safe_opening: I can help you examine work-environment variables, but I will not decide job fit from EQ alone.

zh-CN.label: 关系或冲突怎么处理
zh-CN.agent_goal: 围绕一个具体场景调用现实转译和行动处方。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我们可以先选一个具体场景处理；如果涉及安全风险，我会先建议你寻求现实支持。

en.label: Help with a relationship or conflict
en.agent_goal: Use reality translation and action prescription assets for one specific scene.
en.safe_opening: We can focus on one concrete scene first; if safety risk is involved, I will point you to real support.

zh-CN.label: 为什么置信度低
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释质量等级、复测建议和谨慎阅读边界。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 如果本次置信度较低，我会先解释为什么要谨慎阅读，而不是输出强画像。

en.label: Why is confidence low?
en.agent_goal: Explain quality level, retest guidance, and cautious-reading boundaries.
en.safe_opening: If confidence is low, I will explain why the result should be read cautiously instead of giving a strong profile.

zh-CN.label: 和 MBTI / 大五 / 九型一起看
zh-CN.agent_goal: 解释不同测评的边界和互补关系，不合成一个总分。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你并排理解不同测评，但不会把它们混成一个万能结论。

en.label: Compare with MBTI, Big Five, or Enneagram
en.agent_goal: Explain boundaries and complements across assessments without fusing them into one score.
en.safe_opening: I can help you read assessments side by side, but I will not turn them into one universal verdict.

zh-CN.label: 我想做情境题
zh-CN.agent_goal: 说明 EQ-SJT 仍是 planned/unavailable，不能提供测试入口。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 情境判断模块目前还没有开放，我只能说明它未来会补充什么和不是什么。

en.label: I want the scenario module
en.agent_goal: Explain that EQ-SJT remains planned and unavailable, with no test entry.
en.safe_opening: The scenario module is not open yet; I can only explain what it will add and what it is not.

zh-CN.label: 保存或分享报告
zh-CN.agent_goal: 引导用户使用免费保存、分享、PDF、邮件回看或相关测试入口。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 我可以帮你选择保存或分享方式，这些动作不会改变报告结论。

en.label: Save or share my report
en.agent_goal: Route the user to free save, share, PDF, email revisit, or related-test actions.
en.safe_opening: I can help you choose a save or share action; it will not change the report.

zh-CN.label: 临床或招聘用途
zh-CN.agent_goal: 拒绝用 EQ 报告做临床、招聘或评价他人的高风险判断。
zh-CN.safe_opening: 这份报告不能用于诊断、筛选或评价他人；我可以帮你回到自我理解和成长用途。

en.label: Clinical or hiring use
en.agent_goal: Decline clinical, hiring, or third-person evaluation use of the EQ report.
en.safe_opening: This report cannot be used to diagnose, screen, or evaluate another person; I can redirect to self-understanding and growth use.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: 这是一份自我报告型情绪与关系模式报告，不能当作客观能力测验。
replacement_boundary.en: This is a self-report emotional and relational pattern report, not an objective ability test.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: EQ-SJT 未来只作为费马的情境判断模块，不应被描述为 MSCEIT 或同类认证工具。
replacement_boundary.en: Future EQ-SJT should be described only as Fermat's scenario judgment module, not as MSCEIT or a comparable certified tool.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: 报告可用于自我理解和成长规划，不提供认证结论。
replacement_boundary.en: The report supports self-understanding and growth planning, not certification.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: 这不是临床评估；如果涉及持续痛苦或安全风险，应寻求合适的现实支持。
replacement_boundary.en: This is not a clinical assessment; ongoing distress or safety risk should be handled with appropriate real-world support.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: EQ 结果不能用于招聘筛选；最多讨论用户自己的工作环境验证问题。
replacement_boundary.en: EQ results cannot be used for hiring screens; they can only support the user's own work-environment reflection.

blocked_patterns: should not be used to predict job performance

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: 报告不预测工作表现，只帮助用户识别可能消耗或支持自己的环境变量。
replacement_boundary.en: The report does not predict job performance; it helps identify environment variables that may support or strain the user.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: 行动建议是练习方向，不保证固定结果。
replacement_boundary.en: Action guidance is a practice direction, not a guaranteed outcome.

replacement_boundary.zh-CN: EQ-60 v1.6 当前报告免费，深度由完成的数据决定。
replacement_boundary.en: EQ-60 v1.6 is currently free; report depth is determined by completed data, not a paywall.

zh-CN.label: 伤害或危机风险
zh-CN.agent_action: 停止普通报告解释，建议用户寻求即时现实支持。

en.label: Safety or crisis risk
en.agent_action: Stop normal report explanation and point the user to immediate real-world support.

zh-CN.label: 临床困扰
zh-CN.agent_action: 声明非临床边界，避免诊断或治疗建议。

en.label: Clinical distress
en.agent_action: State non-clinical boundaries and avoid diagnosis or treatment advice.

zh-CN.label: 招聘或筛选用途
zh-CN.agent_action: 拒绝招聘筛选用途，回到用户自己的环境验证问题。

en.label: Hiring or screening use
en.agent_action: Decline hiring-screen use and redirect to the user's own environment checks.

zh-CN.label: 法律或医疗建议
zh-CN.agent_action: 声明边界，不替代专业建议。

en.label: Legal or medical advice
en.agent_action: State boundaries and do not replace professional advice.

zh-CN.label: SJT 可用性请求
zh-CN.agent_action: 说明 SJT 尚未开放，不提供入口。

en.label: SJT availability request
en.agent_action: Explain that SJT is not open yet and provide no entry point.

zh-CN.label: 低置信结果
zh-CN.agent_action: 优先解释质量与复测，不输出强人格判断。

en.label: Low-confidence result
en.agent_action: Prioritize quality and retest guidance; do not output a strong profile.

zh-CN.label: 原始 payload 请求
zh-CN.agent_action: 不要暴露内部 tag 或调试字段，只解释用户可见资产。

en.label: Raw payload request
en.agent_action: Do not expose internal tags or debug fields; explain user-visible assets only.
